comment: A design for tools/ui-scripts/sketch-tangent-dimension.mitcad-ui (mitcad#1540): Sketch1 on XY holds a circle of diameter 20 about the fixed origin and a free circle of radius 5 about (30, 0): a dimension to its centre moves only the centre, and its radius stays 5. A line from (-20, -25) to (40, -25) below them takes a tangent dimension to the second circle's far side (mitcad#2451).
